agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their management and supervision.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a final cash dividend of USD 3,013,598 (approximately Rp10.24875 per share) with a recording date of June 4, 2026, and a payment date of June 19, 2026.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was granted authority to appoint a registered Public Accountant or Firm for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine their honorarium.
Agenda #4: Shareholders reappointed Farid Harianto, Retina Rosabai, and Kamen Kamenov Palatov, and appointed Feri Wibisono as a new Independent Commissioner with terms lasting until 2029.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved maintaining or adjusting Board of Commissioners remuneration based on committee recommendations and delegated the authority to set Board of Directors remuneration to the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved updating the company's business purposes and activities to align with the Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) and the Online Single Submission (OSS) system.
Agenda #7: The meeting confirmed the leadership members and their terms, including Azis Armand as President Director and Agus Lasmono as President Commissioner.
Agenda #8: The Board of Commissioners is authorized to determine the specific duties and authorities for each member of the Board of Directors.
